motivation.source_audit_finding: The existing inbound/net transport-pressure diagnostics weight prospective moves by command-decision probability and destination probability but omit the command-reliability acceptance draw used by the causal movement code. Already committed orders have passed that draw and are correctly full-weighted.
motivation.interpretation: The existing Phi_net is an intended-order pressure, not the expected successfully executable relocation flux. This contract tests a replacement of that coordinate rather than accreting another arbitrary scalar after the residual-screen stop rule.
motivation.latency_scope: Command latency is intentionally not folded into the replacement scalar because latency changes timing, not eventual command acceptance. It remains a separate delay hypothesis.

candidate.name: rootedstock_execnet12v4
candidate.definition: Committed orders contribute full transport strength. Prospective orders contribute transport_strength * command_decision_probability * command_reliability * destination_probability, with equal subtraction at origin and addition at destination.

fresh_screen.nomination_rule: Zero demonstrably non-equivalent pairs required; 16 branches cannot certify closure.
fresh_screen.falsifier: One or more demonstrably non-equivalent pairs rejects command-reliability correction as sufficient closure.

fresh_confirmation.activation: Only if fresh_screen has zero demonstrably non-equivalent pairs.

stop_rule: If the fresh executable-flux replacement fails, do not add command reliability as a thirteenth scalar. Move to explicit nonlocal source/network state or higher-order spatial closure.
scientific_guard: This is a correction to a synthetic coarse-graining diagnostic. It changes no causal model dynamics and makes no empirical claim about real insurgent command systems.
